generate_controlnet_image: generate an image using StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline with a text prompt and a control condition image like a canny edge map
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method for classifier-free guidance
prepare_control_image: preprocess and resize a control condition image tensor to match the desired height and width for the ControlNet model
validate_pipeline_inputs: validate all input arguments including prompt, control image, conditioning scale, and guidance parameters before generation
setup_timesteps: retrieve and configure the diffusion timestep schedule from a scheduler for a given number of inference steps
